title: Houston spells out a text message he never saw

tellings.quote: text she texted it to me he never saw the text and he spelled out what was on the text

plain: A mother named Katie, from Atlanta, Georgia, says someone sent her a text message that her son Houston never saw, and he then spelled out exactly what it said. She tells it as something she witnessed, on an episode about children said to be able to read minds, and if true it would mean he got the words without seeing them.
